description: Every client's domains and certificates in one inventory: what expires, unlocks or changes.

novel_features.name: Client inventory
novel_features.description: Keep each client's domains and hosts in one local inventory that every sweep and report walks.

novel_features.name: Report
novel_features.description: See, per client, what expires within N days, which registrations are not transfer-locked, new CT certificates and DNS drift, plus what the last sweep could not check.

novel_features.name: Events feed
novel_features.description: Read typed events from each sweep diff (domain.expiring, cert.expiring, ct.new_cert, dns.changed, registrar.unlocked) after a cursor.

novel_features.name: Sweep
novel_features.description: Check every inventoried domain's registration, new CT certificates and DNS, and every inventoried host's live TLS certificate, in one run; then store the results and diff them against the last run.

novel_features.name: TLS probe
novel_features.description: Handshake with a live host and get its chain, expiry, SANs, key, issuer, hostname match and OCSP must-staple as JSON.

novel_features.name: Stalled renewals
novel_features.description: Find hosts still serving an old certificate after a newer one was logged, or past their renewal point with no successor in CT.

novel_features.name: DNS check
novel_features.description: Get NS, MX, SPF, DMARC, CAA and DNSSEC for a domain as one JSON document through the system resolver.

novel_features.name: Issuer anomalies
novel_features.description: Separate certificates from issuers a domain's CAA does not permit, or a first-ever issuer, from routine renewals.

novel_features.name: Unwatched hosts
novel_features.description: List hostnames that have certificates in CT for a client's domains but are not in that client's inventory.
